WITH site_rates AS (
  SELECT si.riskeval, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  GROUP BY si.riskeval
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM site_rates
)
SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(sr.rate - b.avg_rate) AS average_margin_above_benchmark
FROM site_rates AS sr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE sr.rate > b.avg_rate;
